title: Griefer Alert Advancements
description: A moderation datapack that uses advancements to notify when players obtain risky items like TNT, disguised as in-game achievements. Works well with DiscordSRV
body:

_Created for use on my [University Minecraft world (derex smp)](https://derec4.github.io/derexsmp/notbanlist) + randos. Check it out in action, server ip: `mc.longhorns.dev`_

This datapack uses advancements to discreetly notify when players acquire risky items, such as TNT. The notifications appear as in-game achievements, providing a subtle yet effective way to monitor potentially dangerous items, and displaying them in logs. This happens all without having to write external code, relying on supported Vanilla mechanics (in game achievements).

You can then easily see suspicious behavior, like if a player just joins, and immediately acquires diamond gear, flint and steel, and TNT. 
With DiscordSRV integration, these alerts are broadcasted to a designated Discord channel, enabling server administrators to quickly identify and respond to potential rogue players.

It shows players "ItzGeorge29" and "Infernagonal" joining the world, chatting casually, and triggering a sequence of custom game advancements highlighted with yellow borders. Within a short span of conversation, player "ItzGeorge29" triggers advanced achievements in rapid succession, including "Suit Up!", "Stone Age!", "Isn't It Iron Pick!", "Cold Stuff!", "Cover Me with Diamonds!", "Diamonds!!", and "Flint and STEEL!".](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b63fbc9acc3630dfb82106d119ba12f0bf3f684.png) | ![A Discord chat log displaying custom Minecraft server notifications. The log shows a series of user activity messages, including player deaths like "CatgirlAyq was slain by Prison Guard" and "1sadasd fell from a high place." Interspersed are custom game achievements highlighted with a yellow vertical accent bar, showing player "1sadasd" completing advancements like "Hot Stuff!", "Cold Stuff!", "Creepers KO'd!", and "Diamonds!!".](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f14f68963cfe79a96d72acccba3f688546edf64.png) |

Or I guess you can just use this if you want some flashy achievements for when your players pick up a bucket of water. Or want to mimic Jack Black from the Minecraft movie.
